Reasons for you to choose KEYA as a brand to buy your dream home.

Ready to move-in project with OC received. We will hand over your home to you within 7 from the booking date
Seeing is believing- you would see your actual home at the time of booking

Top-notch luxury finishes in the segment.

Due to ready to move-in project, you would certainly save Rs. 40-80 lacs of interest on your total cost.

A quick brief about the project is provided below.

LOCATION - Banerghatta Road in South Bangalore is the most promising location and is well-connected to the entire city. This is a buzzing place and people want to raise a toast at their dream home in this locality.

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY - The project has been designed with 81% open space. We have 1,10,000 SFT of lung space at the podium for you. In 3.05 Acres of land, we have planned to build only 271 units with a combination of 2,3 and 4 BHK having SBU of 2BHK - 1335 - 1375 sft, 3BHK - 1695 - 1920 sft, 3BHK (with home office/domestic help room)- 2270 Sft and 4BHK - 2700 sft range.
PROJECT COMMERCIALS -
LOAN OPTIONS- We have exciting offers from various banks for loan processing. You can opt upto 90% home loan of your total cost. You can also avail 95% of home loan funding from Tata on total cost.

The making of KEYA SPRING

SIGNATURE LIFESTYLE CLUB VERDE- You would own and enjoy dedicated 17,000+ SFT "Club Verde" at your doorstep, where sports meets leisure, pampering you with five-star amenities to make your day to day life dynamic yet soothing. We have 50+ lifestyle amenities at the project which would ensure that you find your interest in the project irrespective of your age.
SPORTS/FITNESS - Right from multipurpose football
court/basketball hook/box cricket court to a cricket pitch to the outdoor badminton court to a 2500 SFT KOMPAN kids play park to a temperature-controlled infinity pool (to name a few), we have ensured that you have all the reasons to step out of your home and play sports of your choice at the project.

SUNLIGHT/VENTILATION/PRIVACY - Your home has been built on an east/west and south orientation to make sure that you get direct sunlight for half of the day and daylight for the rest of the day. We have provided windows with maximum opening to ensure you enjoy the fresh air and light in your home.

MATERIAL/FINISHES - We have handpicked the finishes for your home as you would have done while making your home. Rest assured to have a pleasant experience when you get to know about the ingredients of your new home.

WATER MANAGEMENT - We do understand the sensitivity towards rationalized use of water and recycling. We have taken a step forward in this design to make this project 100% water-neutral. You have a combination of STP / WWTP / UV / RO / RAIN WATER HARVESTING to make sure that we reuse the water to the best possible level and have minimal dependency on outside water.

GREEN INITIATIVES - Your homes come with fully loaded green/environment-friendly initiatives. A few of them are listed below

100 KW of Solar Power plant for the project

ZERO water discharge project

Garbage Composting system for your waste management

Sensor-based lighting system for the common area for optimum usage

Dedicated EV car charging facility for each home

1,00,000 SFT + open space at podium level at the project to help you breathe your in-house generated oxygen


The offered price is fixed and is valid for a very limited period and will be increased soon.

title: Green Boulevard
subtitle: 2, 3 BHK Flats
description:
21st Castle Green Boulevard is B+G+8 Residential Apartment Project housing 336 Units across 3.4 Acres of lush green landscape cautiously away from the hustle-bustle and pollution of the city, but just about close to prime locations.

The Project is strategically located off Sarjapur Attibele Road, close to Indus International Residential School and Ajim Premji University Campus. It puts you right at the center of everything in a rapidly developing neighborhood of South-East Bengaluru. It offers excellent connectivity to Sarjapur, Hosur Road, Electronic City, Whitefield and HSR Layout. Work hubs, schools, quality health care facilities, malls and hotels are all within close reach.

Green Boulevard is an abode of green open space homes with all the modern features required for a contemporary lifestyle and are vastu compliant, well ventilated and are very spacious with over 70% of living area assurance. These Residential homes with over 70% open space ratio, flaunt a forest-like environment that gives cleaner, fresher, purer air in every breath you take, The Project is also equipped with various resident-centric super luxury lifestyle amenities that includes a luxurious club house and 20+ lifestyle amenities.

The project has been developed by 21st Castle Developers LLP and has BMRDA approval with RERA No - PRM/KA/RERA/1251/308/PR/310322/004804 and also has been approved by most of the major banks. The project is of conventional RCC framed structure with concrete block masonry and as per the area plan is in the size ranges of 1BHKs (357 Sft to 540 Sft), 2BHKs (711 Sft to 962 Sft), 3BHKs (1033 Sft to 1245 Sft) and optional 3/4 BHKs Simplex/Duplex (1704 Sft to 2262 Sft). Assured with quality construction, premium specs and uncompromised features, 21st Castle Green Boulevard is suitable for both first time Home seekers & Investors and fits into every budget and lifestyle requirement.

title: SJR Parkway Homes Phase 2
subtitle: 1, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5 BHK Flats
description:
Are you looking forward to live in a place that is close to your workplace and at the same time offers a quality of living of the highest standards? Look no further, for SJR PrimeCorp presents Parkway Homes, some of the best flats for sale near Electronic City and also built by one of the best real estate developers in Bangalore.






Located in close proximity to Sarjapur Road, HSR layout and Mico Bosch, it holds the reputation of being one of the most well planned neighbourhoods in Bangalore’s IT Corridor and is also located close to the city’s busiest financial centres.






The property has undergone extensive planning that maximises the availability of living space and allows a resident to have 9.5 acres of serene open space. It has 7 towers each with 14 floors, with an imposing facade, radiating a quiet impression made better with bay windows that capture everyone’s attention.






The area comprises of technology companies like Mahindra Satyam, Infosys and Wipro. And state-of-the-art hospitals like Narayana Hrudayalaya and Ram Krishna Hospital.






Also located nearby are educational institutions like the Blue Bell Public School, New Bishop Cotton High School, Sorsfort International School and the Oxford School. The property is also very close to shopping centres like Total Mall Sarjapur and the Coupon Hosur Road.






Parkway Homes is the perfect example of a property where there is maximum efficiency in terms of space, for every available area has been put to good use. The sprawling 9.5 acre campus employs innovative design across the apartment blocks, gardens, amenities and the clubhouse.






The seven blocks, named after some of the greatest scientists of all time, are made to stand wide apart, with the distance between each one of them being equal to their height. This is done to make sure that every home gets an abundance of fresh air and natural light. The greenery and the space between the blocks are designed by international experts in landscape architecture.






The interiors are expertly designed in order to give every resident a sense of space and luxury. With the granite kitchen interiors and flooring, polished teakwood door frames, vitrified tiles and an abundance of fresh air and natural light, you can be certain that your new home will be the dream home that you may have envisaged for a very long time.






We at SJR Corp understand every resident’s need for personal space and as such, the apartments are designed keeping that factor in mind. The bedrooms are isolated from the rest of the home and the layout of apartments around each building is optimized for privacy.






The amenities are designed in a way that you can lay back and relax at the end of a long day, and also that can encourage you to come up with creative ideas, making it the perfect place to spend time with your family. We are equipped with indoor badminton courts, basketball half courts, cycling tracks, swimming pools, children’s play area and a library.

Located in close proximity to Sarjapur Road, HSR layout and Mico Bosch, it holds the reputation of being one of the most well planned neighbourhoods in Bangalore’s IT Corridor and is also located close to the city’s busiest financial centres.

  
  
  
  
  

The property has undergone extensive planning that maximises the availability of living space and allows a resident to have 9.5 acres of serene open space. It has 7 towers each with 14 floors, with an imposing facade, radiating a quiet impression made better with bay windows that capture everyone’s attention.

  
  
  
  
  

The area comprises of technology companies like Mahindra Satyam, Infosys and Wipro. And state-of-the-art hospitals like Narayana Hrudayalaya and Ram Krishna Hospital.

  
  
  
  
  

Also located nearby are educational institutions like the Blue Bell Public School, New Bishop Cotton High School, Sorsfort International School and the Oxford School. The property is also very close to shopping centres like Total Mall Sarjapur and the Coupon Hosur Road.

The seven blocks, named after some of the greatest scientists of all time, are made to stand wide apart, with the distance between each one of them being equal to their height. This is done to make sure that every home gets an abundance of fresh air and natural light. The greenery and the space between the blocks are designed by international experts in landscape architecture.

  
  
  
  
  

The interiors are expertly designed in order to give every resident a sense of space and luxury. With the granite kitchen interiors and flooring, polished teakwood door frames, vitrified tiles and an abundance of fresh air and natural light, you can be certain that your new home will be the dream home that you may have envisaged for a very long time.

  
  
  
  
  

We at SJR Corp understand every resident’s need for personal space and as such, the apartments are designed keeping that factor in mind. The bedrooms are isolated from the rest of the home and the layout of apartments around each building is optimized for privacy.

  
  
  
  
  

The amenities are designed in a way that you can lay back and relax at the end of a long day, and also that can encourage you to come up with creative ideas, making it the perfect place to spend time with your family. Your home has been built on an east/west orientation to make sure that you get direct sunlight for half of the day and daylight for the rest of the day. We have provided windows with maximum opening to ensure you enjoy the fresh air and light in your home. MATERIAL/FINISHES

200 KW of Solar Power plant for the project
ZERO water discharge project

Dedicated EV car charging facility for each home
ZERO open car parking in the project 6300+ plants/trees planned at the project to help you breathe your in-house generated oxygen.

Sobha Windsor by Sobha Limited is an upcoming residential project in Vijay Nagar, Whitefield, Bangalore. The project offers 2, 3, and 4 BHK apartments with a size range of 1350 to 2292 sq. ft. It will consist of 11 towers with a total of 738 units. The project is designed to be Vastu compliant and offers a host of modern amenities.

Sobha Limited is a well-known real estate developer in India. The company was established in 1994 and has developed several landmark projects across the country. Sobha Limited is known for its quality construction, timely delivery, and customer-centric approach.

The project has 24x7 security with CCTV surveillance, intercom facility, power backup, and sewage treatment plant. Curated parks and a lobby area are some of the highlights of the project.

description:
Brigade Utopia is a brilliantly outlined project by Brigade Groups coming up in opulent locales off Varthur Road, Bangalore-East. The premise sprawls over a vast land enclosure of 45 acres and offers 4000 plus units of 2 & 3 Bedroom apartments hosted over elevated towers having ground plus 26 floor frame-up. The size of the 2 BHK regular units is 1240 square feet (SBA per unit); it is 1905 square feet for 2 BHK Large and 1689 square feet for 3 BHK apartments.
Brigade Utopia is a reflection of urban trends blended utterly with conventional roots to bestow ostentatious livelihood to its in-dwellers. The township features 2 and 3 Bedroom luxury abodes with modern interiors, exteriors, specifications and amenities. The royalty of Brigade projects shows up eminently in this project too with grand entrance, flourishing landscapes, water features, tree- lined walk paths, well-maintained campus, organised parking slots and other infrastructure frame-work. The residential towers are enrooted in right geographic locations with an insight of providing good outdoor views and excellent ventilation of daylight and fresh air. The master plan of the Brigade Utopia shows the presence of various residential towers, beautiful landscaping and outdoor amenities assembled brilliantly to bestow best housing experience to its esteemed occupants.
The specifications related to foundation, Flooring/tiling, Masonry, home security, joinery, lift, sanitary, painting, plumbing and electrical departments are of high-standards and quality. Each department is handled by group of skilled workers under the supervision of top Architects, Civil Engineers, landscape consultants and Structural Experts to deliver a product that tops in elegance and eminence.
Brigade Utopia is aided with upscale amenities and facilities which includes a signature clubhouse, fully equipped gymnasium, separate swimming pools for adults & kids, multi-purpose hall, health club, senior citizen festoon, Meditation/Yoga Deck, aerobics zone, library, squash/ badminton/tennis court, snooker/ carom/chess/ cards room, Children’s play zone with sand pit, amphitheatre, tree-lined walking/cycling tracks, garden area, water features, lawny courtyards, in-house waste management system, water purification systems, rain water harvesting schemes, 24/7 water & power supply, speedy lifts, well organised parking slots and round the clock security monitoring systems.
Brigade Utopia is a brain child of leading construction brand of Brigade Groups which is one of the top real-estate firms of the country with projects spread across major cities of India which includes Bangalore, Chennai, Chikmagalur, Hyderabad, Kochi, Mangalore and Mysore. Brigade Group is headquartered in Bangalore, and has branch offices in several cities in South India and a representative office in Dubai. Brigade projects are known their quality construction and innovative outlines. Their work in various residential and commercial assignments has been outstanding which has earned commendable reviews and credits from happy customers. Few of top projects by Brigade Groups are: Brigade Meadows, Brigade Exotica, Brigade Golden Triangle, Brigade Woods, Brigade Caladium, Brigade Cosmopolis, Brigade Crescent, Brigade Gardenia and Brigade Millennium.
